statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.subtitle: Cumulative performance across all tournaments.
statistics.emptyDescription: Create tournaments and enter scores to see cumulative per-participant performance.
statistics.scorersEmptyDescription: When entering a match score, add the goal scorers to build the top-scorer ranking.
statistics.note: Tit = titles · Trn = tournaments · P = played · W/D/L · GF = goals for · GD = goal diff. Goals are per participant (match scores); individual top-scorer tracking is in the Top scorers tab.

typesDescription.doubleElimination: Double elimination: a loss drops you to the losers bracket; you're only out after a second loss. 4, 8, or 16 teams.
typesDescription.roundRobin: Everyone plays everyone. Most points wins.
typesDescription.leaguePlayoff: Home-and-away round-robin with volleyball scoring. Top 4 play the final and 3rd-place match.
typesDescription.worldCup: World Cup template: 8 groups × 4 → R16 → QF → SF → Final + 3rd. Editable.
typesDescription.custom: Define your own phases and formats.

tournament.deleteMessage: This action cannot be undone. All participants and matches will be removed too.

matches.bracketResetHint: Because the losers bracket champion won the 1st grand final, both teams now have one loss. This match decides the champion.

participants.title: Participants
participants.emptyDescription: Add participants to start generating matches.
participants.deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to remove this participant?
participants.deleteWhileBracketMessage: The bracket is already generated. Removing this participant will leave their matches blank — regenerate the bracket afterwards to fix it (this clears all scores).
participants.bracketLockedNotice: Bracket generated. Renaming and changing badges is safe and shows up instantly. Adding or removing participants requires regenerating the bracket (clears scores).
participants.addWhileBracketMessage: The bracket is already generated. The new participant will only play if you regenerate the bracket, which clears any scores already entered.

about.title: About
about.description: Run your tournaments anywhere — no internet needed. Pick the format, add the players, and enter the scores — the app builds the bracket and tracks the standings. From a Sunday kickabout to a championship with friends.

image.title: Tournament image
image.shareUnavailable: Sharing is not available on this device.
image.savedMessage: The tournament image has been saved to your gallery.
image.saveDeniedMessage: To save the image, grant gallery access in the app settings.

phaseBuilder.title: Tournament phases
phaseBuilder.thirdPlaceHint: Adds an extra match between the two semifinal losers.
phaseBuilder.bracketResetHint: If the losers bracket champion wins the grand final, a 2nd rematch decides the champion.

errors.lastPhaseHasQualifiers: The last phase cannot have qualifiers.
errors.firstPhaseNoQualifiers: Set how many teams advance from the first phase.
errors.qualifiersMustBeEven: Playoffs need an even number of qualifiers ({{got}} is odd).
errors.singleElimMultiGroupUnsupported: Multi-group → knockout requires an even group count and qualifiers = 2× groups (top-2 from each).
errors.secondPhaseMustNotBeRoundRobin: The second phase must be Knockout or Playoffs.
errors.doubleElimMustBeStandalone: Double elimination must be the only phase of the tournament.
